name: Title card
what: A finished title screen in four looks: an editorial title with a big serif word whose letters rise and breathe; an event card with words rising over a soft shape; two names with an ampersand blurring in (an invitation); or a product line with a sound-wave strip and a button popping.

learned_from.what: a small top line, a huge serif word whose letters rise and lean, a bottom line
a product title rising with a soft background shape
words blurring in over a sound-wave strip, a button popping
an event title building up line by line
two names and an ampersand blurring in one after another

motion: letters rise 16 f, 3 f apart (slow end), then breathe; lines blur in 20 f, 10 f apart; the button back.out 12 f
